name: cc-notify-mod
description: Forward Claude Code task completion, repeated Bash failures, and AskUserQuestion prompts to the macOS Notification Center so you hear about them when you are away from the terminal.

enabled.title: Enable system notifications
enabled.description: Master switch. When false, no system notifications are sent and the band shows the mod as muted.

suppressWhenFocused.title: Suppress when the terminal is the frontmost app
suppressWhenFocused.description: Skip notifications when Claude Code is the focused app (no point interrupting yourself). Set to false to notify regardless of focus.

stickyOnError.title: Sticky notifications on error
stickyOnError.description: Forwarded warning notifications stay on screen until dismissed. Only takes effect when terminal-notifier is installed (see README); otherwise macOS auto-dismisses.
